independent_peer_review.finding: No concrete forward/transpose, synchronization, candidate-offset or checkpoint-index defect found. Disjoint-column geometry prevents diagonal pair lookups; finalcheckpoint increments ncheck only on the last iteration.

correctness_review.finding: Quota8 and cap<=9 gathers agree with full99 A; transpose has4quota+9cap terms. A disjoint unknown edge cannot coincide with an overlap neighbor, so pair_index never sees a diagonal in transpose.

Strict integer counts, finite X/Y boxes,168distinctcanonicaledges,degree4,allfull99caps and336exactownquotas are checked before launching. RHS is an exact integer in0..2 derived from reconstructed full99 adjacency.
